email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGlutide patient with a mild headache
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am an a member of staff at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 80-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their third dose of DemoGlutide (dose: 0.5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-04-11.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild headache.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

[Message forwarded from a shared inbox; original sender identity was not preserved.]
